sku_taken: You already have a product with that code.
empty_update: There are no changes to save.
unknown_unit: That unit of measure doesn't exist.
catalog_missing: This account has no product catalog. Please contact support.
too_many_decimals: Amounts allow at most 2 decimal places.
base_unit_locked_by_stock: You can't change the base unit of a product that already has stock.
base_unit_locked_by_composition: You can't change the base unit: this product is a component of another one.
is_component: Can't delete it: this product is a component of another one.
presentation_name_taken: A presentation with that name already exists for this product.
barcode_taken: That barcode is already used by another product.
default_presentation_required: The product needs a default sale presentation.
component_not_found: One of the selected components doesn't exist.
composition_cycle: That relationship forms a cycle: one of the products would end up containing itself. Remove the reverse composition before adding this one.
import_empty: The file has no rows to import.
import_unreadable: We couldn't read the file. Make sure it's the CSV or Excel template.
import_too_large: The file is over 5 MB. Please split it into smaller parts.
import_missing_required: The code or the name is missing.
import_duplicate_sku: This code is repeated within the file.
import_has_errors: The file has rows with errors. Fix them or check the option to import only the valid ones.
